visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An adult Asian male in a festive white sweater with red bow patterns and a Santa-hat-topped headband with bear ears is smiling widely. Beside him, a young girl with reddish-brown hair and green-rimmed glasses wearing a white sweater with a bear emblem looks on. They stand in front of the ornate, snow-dusted Sleeping Beauty Castle at Disneyland and then the Pixar Pal-A-Round ferris wheel under a bright, sunny sky with many tourists visible in the background. (2) The duo is now positioned along a parade route where characters including Mickey Mouse in Korean traditional dress are riding floats. The girl waves her hand excitedly at the camera while the man maintains his exuberant expression. Later, they are outdoors near characters from Inside Out and a Santa performer; the man holds a corn dog topped with mustard and ketchup, showing it to the lens. (3) Transitions to high-action rides. First, they are on the Silly Symphony Swings, spinning through the air with palms and park scenery behind them. Then, they are seated in a dark ride vehicle, both wearing yellow-rimmed 3D glasses. The man vigorously steers a blue and white control wheel while the girl sits beside him, looking intensely at the unseen screen. (4) The scene shifts to the girl riding a carousel horse in a brightly lit, circular venue with festive colors. This is followed by a dark ride interior where neon colors dominate, specifically a Toy Story-themed area. The man and girl are holding white and blue blasters, aiming at moving targets amidst glowing green dinosaur and alien set pieces. (5) They are seen on a high-speed vehicle ride at dusk, possibly Radiator Springs Racers, with the camera shaking as they navigate through a dark wooded area. The man and girl have their mouths open in excitement. The video then cuts to them at night, possibly on a shuttle or tram, with the background blurred into streaks of light as they move quickly. (6) The final scene takes place at night against a dark sky. The man and girl are in the foreground, with the girl making a peace sign with her hand. Behind them, vibrant red and green fireworks explode in the sky, illuminating the scene. The man smiles warmly into the camera, capturing the celebratory end to their day.

SFX: Prominent sound of a crowd cheering and clapping in sync with the parade movement. A soft rustling sound is heard as the corn dog is held up. (4) Vocal: Girl's voice enters with a clear, melodic "好好玩喔" followed by male shouts. Music: Classic carousel organ music with a whimsical, repeating melody. SFX: Frequent and dense electronic SFX consisting of synthesized bubble pops and digital "impact" sounds as they play the shooting game, creating a busy audio environment. (6) Vocal: Male speaks the final catchphrase with a slightly lower, more satisfied volume. Music: Orchestral swells reaching a climax.
